exercises.question: Explain the effect of high temperature on enzyme activity.
exercises.question_amharic: ከፍተኛ የሙቀት መጠን በኢንዛይሞች ሥራ ላይ የሚያሳድረውን ተጽዕኖ ያብራሩ።
exercises.correct_answer: High temperature denatures the enzyme, changing its active site shape so it can no longer bind substrates.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ኢንዛይሙን ያበላሸዋል (denature)፣ ቅርፁን ስለሚቀይር መስራት አይችልም።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Enzymes have optimal temperature bounds.\n2. Above optimal limit, heat breaks hydrogen bonds.\n3. The active site loses shape (denaturation).
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Enzymes have optimal temperature bounds.\n2. Above optimal limit, heat breaks hydrogen bonds.\n3. The active site loses shape (denaturation).
